enabled_when: FEEDBACK_ADMIN_SHA256 is a lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest of the administrator 64-hex Bearer secret

controller.visibility: current device and current claim only

owner.visibility: all claims on this device, including after AI revocation

anonymous.authentication: POST can be unauthenticated; recommended: save a fresh 64-hex receipt Bearer before first POST. Item GET/DELETE and same-ID replay require that receipt Bearer. Store only its SHA-256 hash.

administrator.authentication: 64-hex admin Bearer whose SHA-256 equals the configured digest; no phone control authority

create.report_id: lowercase UUIDv4 string; generate and save before sending

controller_patch.supplement: nonempty string, at most 4000 Unicode code points; max 5 supplements per report; PATCH is not automatically retried after an uncertain response

administrator_patch.maintenance_reply: nonempty string, at most 4000 Unicode code points, optional; at least one field required

pagination.cursor: opaque base64url up to 256 characters, HMAC bound to role/device/claim/filter scope; preserve exact value
pagination.ordering: report_id lexicographic; an empty page may have next_cursor when filters skip records

idempotency.same_id_same_original_body: 200 receipt with replayed:true, no additional write allowance consumed
idempotency.deleted_id: 410 report_deleted until original expiry; deletion stores only identity/authorization hashes and expiry, no body
idempotency.after_expiry: original record and tombstone are removed; generate a fresh UUID for a new report, never automatically retry expired submissions
idempotency.anonymous_response_loss: same saved report_id+receipt Bearer can retry safely; without the saved receipt credential the original report cannot be recovered by ID alone

deduplication: duplicate_of points only to an identical original payload in the same device+claim; each report remains independent. Anonymous reports are individually private and do not cross-reference other reports.

limits.ingress: independent feedback bucket; existing edge limits apply
limits.deletes: not charged to report write allowance
limits.control: no phone sequence or daily command quota is consumed

create_body.title: Screen preparation did not finish
create_body.description: After requesting a screenshot, the device remained asleep. No private app content is attached.

report.title: Screen preparation did not finish
report.maintenance_reply: Please tell us the Android version.

privacy: No screenshots, UI trees, HTTP headers or credential fields are accepted. Free text is caller-redacted. Feedback code logs no submitted content or credentials, makes no model calls and performs no automatic GitHub synchronization. Maintainer detail additionally includes device_id and claim_id, or null for anonymous reports.
